name: AWS Richmond County data center campus
summary: Amazon Web Services campus in rural Richmond County, North Carolina, near the South Carolina line. Announced in June 2025 at an estimated $10 billion for cloud and AI infrastructure, with at least 500 jobs. The county approved 20-year cash grants tied to property taxes, contingent on job and investment targets. Amazon broke ground in October 2025, said in July 2026 that the campus would have 21 buildings, and has applied for an air permit for backup generators. County officials said water, wastewater and fiber upgrades would come at no cost to taxpayers.

location.note: The opened sources name only Richmond County (the announcement was held in Hamlet); coordinates are the county point from its Wikipedia article (Nominatim was unavailable).
